title: Efficacy and safety of first-line chemoimmunotherapy versus chemotherapy alone for advanced pulmonary lymphoepithelioma-like carcinoma: a systematic review and real-world cohort study.

Regarding tolerability, the risk of grade ≥ 3 adverse events (AEs) did not differ significantly between the two arms (pooled RR = 0.94, 95% CI: 0.74–1.19, P = 0.599; I² = 0%), indicating that the addition of first-line immunotherapy did not significantly increase the severe toxicity burden ( Figures 3 , 4 , Table 2 ).
